description: Provenance of every file in this directory. 'captured' files are the unedited bytes an engine wrote; 'derived' files are one of those reports or sessions with exactly one status field edited, for a status no subject reproduces. sha256 is of the file as committed. The directory holds only .json, .sqlite and .txt files, so DYD-96's inventory never classifies a fixture as maintained source; subject sources are recorded here as data and were captured in a throwaway directory outside the repository. Every Cosmic Ray session was captured through the adapter's own rendering -- shlex.join([sys.executable, <run>/python/suite_runner.py, *manifest argv]) JSON-escaped into the TOML basic string, with the generated in-process suite runner as the command's only entry point, including for the sessions whose engine never launches it -- in a run/snapshot layout that matches the adapter's. Each session's 'markerNonce' is the capture nonce substituted into that session's generated runner as the literal the adapter substitutes with its run uuid; the normalization examples pass it to mutation_summary, and a session re-read under any other nonce carries no completion marker.
